_comment: IFR full departure simulation LFLP -> LFMN. SimBrief FPL: cruise FL270, SID ODIK2A RW22. CIFP binding alt FL150 (ODIKI) with the FL130 floor at LP610, initial climb 6500ft (transition_alt from apt.dat 1302). Frequencies from apt.dat: GND 121.730, TWR 118.200, APP 121.205 (Chambery). No Delivery and no ATIS, so the IFR clearance is requested from GROUND -- Annecy has a Ground frequency (user 2026-08-10, a recent real-world addition). The scenario originally opened on TOWER expecting a direct clearance; the redirect guard correctly sends a Tower clearance request to Ground when a Ground frequency exists, so the old step 1 left the state at IDLE and cascaded into 17 failed assertions.
name: IFR departure — LFLP (Annecy) → LFMN via ODIK2A, FL270

say.note: 1 - Ground: IFR clearance request (no Delivery, no ATIS -> Ground delivers)
say.text: Annecy Ground Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta request IFR clearance to Nice

say.note: 2 - Readback of the clearance -> startup approved. The squawk MUST match the one ATC assigned: readback verification (shipped after this scenario was written) rejects a wrong code with "negative, I say again, squawk NNNN". generate_squawk() uses std::rand(), which atc_repl never seeds, so the code is deterministic here (1724); the plugin seeds from the clock in main.cpp and will differ in sim.
say.text: Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta cleared to Nice as filed via ODIK2A initial climb six thousand five hundred squawk one seven two four QNH one zero one three

say.note: 3 - Ground: request taxi. The clearance no longer names a lettered holding point (single holding point since the v4.5 ground rework); it also now asks the pilot to verify the squawk in mode Charlie.
say.text: Annecy Ground Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta request taxi
Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta taxi to holding point runway two two

say.note: Squawk set to the assigned code in Mode C before reporting holding short. mode 3 = ALT; mode 2 is only Mode A and fails the >=3 check.
6 — Ground: at holding point → contact Tower on 118.200
say.text: Annecy Ground Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta holding short runway two two

say.note: 7 — Tower: holding short → line up and wait RW22
say.text: Annecy Tower Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta holding short runway two two

say.note: 8 — Tower: ready → cleared for takeoff, climb runway heading, squawk
say.text: Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta ready for departure

say.note: 9 - Takeoff readback, silent when COMPLETE. The clearance now ends with "report passing 3000 feet" and readback verification requires that item too; an incomplete readback leaves one pending, which later makes the Approach check-in classify as READBACK instead of an initial call.
say.text: Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta runway two two cleared for takeoff report passing three thousand feet

say.note: 10 - Above the LFLP CTR ceiling the handoff fires: contact Chambery Approach. State goes to IFR/FREQ_HANDOFF and STAYS there until the pilot checks in ON the new frequency -- the handoff check-in gate. There is no readback on the old frequency: the precondition rejects it ("you are still with ..."), so IFR/EN_ROUTE is simply not visited on this path.

12 - Chambery Approach check-in -> IFR/RADAR_CONTACT. No text asserted: the first check-in acknowledgement is DEFERRED so it can be merged with the SID step-1 climb into a single "radar contact, climb flight level N" call (arm_checkin_ack_deferral). That merged call is emitted by poll_sid_climb, which this scenario runner does not drive -- it is covered headless by testscripts/ifr_real/afis_lflu_lflp.sh and in sim by SID_TEST_PLAN.md.
say.text: Chambery Approach Fox Golf Bravo Charlie Delta passing four thousand feet climbing to six thousand five hundred
